title: Motion from a sketch
scenario: V01 with I01 and I03: mounted native Moxi app; partial formalization, parameter/target ownership, bounded alternatives, cancellation, failure, stale revision and undo. AppKit content-view raster captures; no desktop compositor or human efficacy claim.
backend: Cocoa / Moxi App + Scene / AppKit content-view capture
fixture: Deterministic informal arm, length 120 px; parameters 45 deg / 1 s; desired knots from 60 deg / 0.75 s

slides.caption: An informal arm beside an unfinished note
slides.expected: Fit and parameter controls disabled; no executable arm

slides.caption: Only the arm becomes executable
slides.expected: 130 px arm; note content and position preserved

slides.caption: Parameter editing owns the blue response
slides.expected: 50 degree peak; original target retained; RETURN active

slides.caption: A desired curve is a cancellable draft
slides.action: Pointer-down on knot 3; drag to 65 degrees
slides.expected: Draft visible; committed target and parameters unchanged

slides.caption: Releasing commits the target alone
slides.expected: Knot 3 is 65 degrees; executable parameters unchanged

slides.caption: Three bounded fits; second candidate previewed
slides.expected: Three valid fits; preview separate from committed parameters

slides.caption: Apply commits a parameter pair atomically
slides.action: Escape rejects preview; find alternatives again; Preview 2 via Tab/Space; click Apply
slides.expected: Selected pair committed; target/length/note retained; keyboard undo/redo checked next

slides.caption: The bounded search yields between batches
Cancelled search cannot apply later
slides.expected: Cancelled; committed pair and desired knots preserved

slides.caption: Keyboard editing has the same draft boundary
slides.expected: Draft rises five degrees; committed curve unchanged; Cmd+Z cancels just the draft

slides.caption: Pinned endpoints reject target edits
slides.action: Commit/undo a keyboard draft; Previous knot three times; Target +5 via Tab/Space
slides.expected: Committed keyboard edit undoes; start stays zero without revision change

slides.caption: Unsupported target fails within the stated grid
slides.action: Drag knot 3 to 120 degrees; Find alternatives; 40 ticks
slides.expected: No fit within six degrees RMS; implementation unchanged; target retained

slides.caption: Undo restores the prior desired curve
slides.expected: Prior target restored without changing the applied implementation

slides.caption: Editing invalidates a pending result
slides.expected: STALE; Apply disabled; no late parameter overwrite

slides.caption: Undo formalization returns to the sketch
slides.expected: Original sketch kind, length, note content and position restored

slides.caption: The minimum native window retains every control
slides.expected: Every declared control stays inside the content height
